_comment: SURVEYED. The jeepney that carries people from the General Trias side straight through to SM
Dasmarinas / Pala-Pala without a transfer. It is genuinely missing from OpenStreetMap -- verified
2026-08-26 against the live database, where the only services boarding at Bella Vista are SM
Molino, Trece Martires, and the two BT Vista Mall runs.
Stop list confirmed 2026-08-28: Bella Vista, Vista Mall General Trias, Manggahan Junction, LPU
Cavite, Pala-Pala, SM City Dasmarinas. 'Waltermart Manggahan' as reported is not a named stop in
the database; Manggahan Junction is the existing stop nearest that boarding point and is what
this file uses. 'near' on the LPU Cavite entries only breaks a tie between two DB rows 108m
apart (the two kerbs of that stop) -- the app already merges them into one routing node at that
distance, so either resolves to the same place.
name: Jeepney: General Trias to SM Dasmarinas via Pala-Pala
notes: Surveyed 2026-08-28. Single-seat ride connecting General Trias to SM Dasmarinas that OpenStreetMap does not map.
